title: Remote Virus and Malware Removal
headline: Remove supported malware, pop-ups, and browser hijackers from an enrolled device.
description: Remote virus and malware cleanup for enrolled devices when the computer can still connect safely through the Remote Support Plan.
metaTitle: Remote Malware Removal for Central Florida Plan Clients
metaDescription: Remove supported malware, pop-ups, browser hijackers, and unwanted software remotely from devices enrolled in the Remote Support Plan.

sections.heading: Did You Know?
paragraph: Malware can change browser settings, install unwanted software, or run automatically when the computer starts.
Remote cleanup is possible only when the device can start and connect safely.
Severe infections, damaged systems, or computers that cannot be trusted after cleanup may require local service or a clean rebuild.

sections.heading: What We Remove
items: Common malware, adware, and unwanted software
Browser hijackers, fake alerts, and unauthorized extensions
Suspicious startup items and scheduled tasks
Supported persistence mechanisms found during cleanup

sections.heading: What to Expect
paragraph: This service requires an active Remote Support Plan and an enrolled device.
We first determine whether remote cleanup is safe and appropriate. If it is not, we stop and recommend the right local service.
Access follows the permissions selected during enrollment. We explain what we find, what we remove, and which account or software changes should follow.

faq.question: Do I need the Remote Support Plan first?
faq.answer: Yes. Remote Virus and Malware Removal is available only for devices enrolled in an active Remote Support Plan.

faq.question: Can all malware be removed remotely?
faq.answer: No. Remote cleanup works only when the device can connect safely and the infection is within the supported recovery scope. Some cases require local service or a clean rebuild.

faq.question: What happens after the cleanup?
faq.answer: We explain what was found, review safer settings, and identify any password, account, update, or backup steps that should follow.
